rope.name: Steel wire rope, 6×36 IWRC, EIPS, galvanised
rope.why: Keeps about half its strength at 550 °C, unlike polymer ropes; zinc coating for salt air

al6061.name: Aluminium 6061-T6
al6061.why: Light, weldable pod frame; does not spark; good corrosion resistance

s355.name: Structural steel S355, hot-dip galvanised
s355.why: Anchors, magnet back-iron, rails; tough and easy to weld

ss316.name: Stainless steel 316
ss316.why: Axles, pins and fasteners in marine air

ph174.name: Stainless steel 17-4PH (H1025)
ph174.why: Release-latch pawl and pin: high strength, small parts

ndfeb.name: NdFeB magnet, grade N42SH, Ni-Cu-Ni coated
ndfeb.why: Strong permanent field with no power; SH grade resists heat and demagnetising

copper.name: Copper C11000 (ETP)
copper.why: Brake fin: eddy-current force grows with conductivity (aluminium gives ≈ 43 %)

pa6.name: Cast nylon PA6 sheave liner
pa6.why: Quiet, low-wear contact on the rope; protects rope wires

chain.name: Steel chain, graded 14–32 kg/m (proof-coil to stud-link)
chain.why: Drag-chain arrester: stopping force depends on chain picked up, not on speed

pet.name: Polyester (PET) webbing, UV-stabilised
pet.why: Backup catch net and 4-point harnesses; low stretch, does not rot

concrete.name: Reinforced concrete C30/37 with B500B rebar
concrete.why: Terminus deadman, counterweight, landing pit, bunker
